player_prompt.intro:
Wamkelekile kwi-Lights Out! Unayo isithili {size}x{size} selayiti.
Inhloso yakho kukhomba zonke selayiti KUSIWE (kubonakala ngoku '.')
Ungakwazi ukukhomba iselayiti, iyathetha ngokwakhe NA abantu abangaphakathi (phezulu/naphakathi/kwaphandle/kwesokunene).
Bhala [row col] ukukhomba iselayiti (0-igidi, kwa hiyo kufika kwi-0-{max_index}).
Unayo zikomo {max_turns} ukukhomba ukuthula iphazamiso.
Incwadi: 'O' = iselayiti IKHOMBE, '.' = iselayiti KUSIWE

invalid_move.wrong_format: Isenzo kufuneka sibe kwifomathi [row col] apho umgca kunye necol ziyinombolo ukusuka ku-0 ukuya ku-{max_index}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Izikoordineeti kufuneka zibe phakathi kwe-0 no-{max_index}. Uvulele [{row},{col}].

outcome.win: Ndiyavuyisana nawe, usombulule iphazili ngeendlela ezi- {moves_used}!
